title: actionLayout.record 的说明只提页头，落地 #36494 后还管行菜单和右键菜单
body:
triage#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZKP5YM48rWMWTS7wE

Filing gate: ① a shipped authoring sentence that will be wrong, filed by triage at repo:objectstack#3's request (mailbox #36743, comment 7119924174). Source: L1 record 7119889919 on PR #36815 (#36494). That PR does not introduce it.
Blocked-by: #36815

## What happens

Once PR #36815 lands, an object's `actionLayout.record` order also orders the grid's row menu and right-click menu. The key's spec `.describe()` text in `packages/spec` still names only the record header surfaces. An author, or an AI writing metadata from the describe, under-reads what the key controls.

reach: read from the PR's L1, not run. It reaches every author who reads the key's description in Studio or the generated docs.

## Expected

The `actionLayout.record` describe names every surface the record order reaches after #36815: the record header, the grid row menu and the right-click menu.

## Acceptance

- The describe text and any generated docs or forms that carry it say what the key now does.
- The contract review the describe change owes, because it is a contract face, records PASS.

Dedupe: open issues for `actionLayout.record` return only #36494, the behaviour card, which is in flight with repo:objectstack#3.
